name: maxs_deli_catering
description: A sample webesite snowcasing how a deli stpre's online menu & ordering will look like!!

paragraphs: A modern, fast, and fully responsive web application built for Max’s Delicatessen located in Wayne, NJ. The site provides customers with quick access to daily specials, full catering options, direct telephone contact, and online third-party delivery options[cite: 1].
features: Dynamic Navbar: Modern, responsive fixed navigation bar[cite: 1, 3] with high-contrast typography, brand logo integration[cite: 1], and a collapsed mobile hamburger menu for seamless navigation on small screens.
Online Delivery Integration: Direct single-tap ordering links for Grubhub, UberEats, and DoorDash[cite: 1] with custom-fitted logo badges.
Hero Banner / Jumbotron: High-impact main header featuring a prominent "Browse Now" call-to-action button[cite: 1].
Interactive Image Carousel: Showcase of signature sandwiches, salads, bagels, and specials[cite: 1].
Feature Cards: Highlighted sections for Today's Specials, Online Ordering, and Third-Party Delivery[cite: 1].
